text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Countless wishes materialize as the New Year draws close,
transforming into a giant monster after swarming together
and possessing the temple's kagami mochi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
新年を目前に大量発生した願い。
それらは集合体となって鏡餅に取り憑き、
巨大な魔物になってしまった。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: How did it come to this?
text_block_list.orig_text: こんなことが起こるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Our first priority is evacuating the temple visitors!
That thing has a dreadful aura emanating from it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかくここからお客さんたちを遠ざけないと！
アレからは禍々しいオーラを感じる。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute.
Isn't it saying something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
何か言ってるみたいだよ？

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why am I so bald?!
My precious puppy won't come home!
Mommy! Where are you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヌ……
ヌケゲナオラナイ！
カッテタワンチャンガモドッテコナイザマス！
オカアサーン！　
ドコニイルノー！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
It's become an amalgamation of multiple wishes...
This won't be easy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろんな思念が混ざり合っているのか……
手強い相手になりそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: W-watch out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
危ない！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Figures it'd go wild!
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱり暴れだしたか！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight! Thank goodness you're okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン！　
無事でよかった！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We're all good here!
But a bunch of wishes have all mixed together into this thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしたちは大丈夫！
でも願いがたくさん集まっちゃって、
こんなことに……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
We need you to take charge.
Give us precise orders.
choice_data_list: Yui. Guide the visitors away from here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミには指揮をとってほしい。
指示を頼む。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Okay! Leave it to me!
choice_data_list: Rei. Keep that thing at bay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
任せて！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
But I'll need you to power me up.
choice_data_list: Hiyori. Go find anyone that can help us fight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
請け負おう。
キミは能力で私を援護して。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Okay-dokie!
I'll be back in a flash!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オッケー！　
すぐ戻ってくるね！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Your opponent stands before you!
And trust me. You won't be getting past me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエたちの相手はこの私だ！
ここから先は、
誰であろうと、
通さないっ！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Phew. You don't honestly think that's enough to take us down, do you?!
Come on, I'm right here! Give me everything you have!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ……
そんなもので私たちを倒せるなどと思うなよ！
さあ、
かかってこい！　
こっちだ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! I need you to get as far away from the temple as possible!
Please give priority to women and children!
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆さーん！　
なるべく神殿の中から出ていてくださーい！
女性と子どもたちを先に通してくださーい！　
お願いしまーす！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Is there anyone confident in their fighting ability here?
We'd appreciate anyone that can help us out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん！　
強い人がいたら、
あたしたちと一緒に戦ってくれませんかー！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hm... This isn't going well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
誰かいないかなー……

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'll help out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい！　
俺は手伝うぜー！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're the person that was looking for the good luck charm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーっ！　
お守りの人だー！

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Sure am!
You helped me out back then, so now it's my turn!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっす！　
お守り、
一緒に探してくれたお礼に戦います！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Count me in!
That blue-haired demonfolk is your friend, isn't she?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワシもやるぞ！　
青い髪の魔族のねーちゃん、
アンタのお仲間なんだろ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You must mean Rei!
She sure is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイさんだ！　
はい！　
あたしたちの仲間です！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
She helped me out a little while ago.
And I'm not one to let a favor go without being repaid!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのねーちゃんにさっき助けてもらったからな。
受けた恩は返すのが俺の生き様よ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Youngster
text_block_list.text: Let me help out as well.
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱり僕も手伝います。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, young'un!
You sure you've got what it takes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい若ぇの！　
おまえ、
やれんのか？

text_block_list.name: Youngster
text_block_list.text:
I do!
My girlfriend's here, so I want to protect her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やります！　
一緒に来てる彼女を守りたいんです！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Well.
Just make sure you don't pull any stunts that'd make her worry, got it?
text_block_list.orig_text: その子に心配かけるような真似だけはすんじゃねえぞ？

text_block_list.name: Youngster
text_block_list.text: Got it!
text_block_list.orig_text: はいっ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! Count me in, too!
I can't let you do all the heavy lifting.
I put out a call to all my buds, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ちな！　
俺も行くぜ！
嬢ちゃんたちだけ行かせはしねぇさ。
今他の仲間も集めてる。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ありがとうございますっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Rei! Mr. Knight!
I brought along a bunch of people that'll help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、
レイさーん！　
騎士くーん！
戦ってくれる人たち、
連れてきたよー！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Perfect timing!
It was starting to be a bit of a struggle on my own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいタイミングだヒヨリ！
実はそろそろキツくなってきたところだったんだ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: All the visitors have been evacuated, too!
text_block_list.orig_text: お客さんたちの避難も終わったよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Good to have you back, Yui!
We should be able to fight back now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイも戻ったか！　
これなら押し返せるな！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Please protect them all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
お願い、
みんなを守って！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Roger! Haaaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解！　
はあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GGRRRUOOOOOOGGGHHH...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Good stuff, Rei!
choice_data_list: Hiyori! The rest's up to you!
text_block_list.orig_text: ナイスレイさん！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Okay-dokie!
Get ready! I'm giving you everything I've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オッケー！　
これがあたしの
全力だあぁぁぁっ！！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GGRRRUOOOOOOGGGHHH...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Great! We've got the upper hand at this rate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし！　
ここから一気に形勢逆転といこう！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mochi-face! I'm gonna turn you back into a pile of rice!
Take this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい餅！　
ワシが粉々にしてやるよ！
オラアァッ！！！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GGRRRUOOOOOOGGGHHH...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Gahaha! Ain't no thang!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がーっはっはっはっは！　
どんなもんだい！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Wow! You sure brought some strong people along!
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒヨリちゃんが連れてきてくれた人たちも強いね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Even better, they're all people we helped today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでしょー？
実はみーんな、
今日あたしたちが助けた人たちなんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I do recognize that axe-wielder, now that you mention it.
Quite the reminder that we should always take care
in how we treat other people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかにあの斧使い、
見覚えがあるよ。
そうか……
やはり人との縁は大切にしないといけないな。

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Another wish incoming!
text_block_list.orig_text: もう新しい鏡餅に願いが憑依してる！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
New Year's isn't far off,
but it's looking like we'll have to deal with more and more at this rate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
新年までもうあまり時間がない。
でも今の様子だと、
コイツ以外にも憑依される物が他にも出てきそうだ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That won't be enough to stop us, though!
It's me, Yui, Rei and Mr. Knight! We can't lose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでもあたしたちは、負けないよっ！
だよね！
　ユイちゃん。
レイさん。
騎士くん！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh? It's trying to take off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
鏡餅がどっか行っちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's going to leave the temple!
We need to stop it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままだと神殿を飛び出しちゃう！
早く止めないと！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
No, let it!
That thing—those things—realized that it's dangerous to stay here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
これでいい！　
ヤツ……
ヤツらは神殿に留まるのが危険だと判断したんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It'll be safer to have the visitors stay close to the temple then, right?
But can we keep them all safe while fighting?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあお客さんには神殿の近くにいてもらったほうが安全だね。
……わたしたち、
ちゃんとみんなを守りながら戦えるかな？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Exactly.
It's time to go all out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうこと。
ここからは全力で行くよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: A hundred and ten percent! Let's do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも、
もーっと頑張るね！

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text: Please leave things here to us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆さん！　
ここは俺たちに任せてください！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
We can handle the small fry here!
You lot take care of the ones outside!
text_block_list.orig_text:
神殿に残ってるのは大したことねえのばっかだから安心しな！
外のヤツらは頼んだぜ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Thanks. We appreciate it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
任せてもらおう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Let's meet up afterwards!
text_block_list.orig_text: また後でー！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──はあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Gummy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
This one's resilient!
It must be the last one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やけに硬いな……！　
コイツが最後の一体か……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: It's a lot tougher than the rest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきまでの鏡餅とは、
比べ物にならない硬さだね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can put a dent in it on my own...
What should I do, Mr. Knight?
choice_data_list: Let's go at it all at once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに硬いとあたしだけじゃ倒せそうにないよー……
騎士くん。
どうしたらいいと思う？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
If there's one thing I'm good at, it's punching away at something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解っ！
とにかくあたしは、
どっかーんで殴っちゃえばいいんだね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'll hold off its next attack, then.
Hiyori, Rei. The rest is up to you after that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
まずはわたしが攻撃を防ぐから、
ヒヨリちゃん。
レイちゃん。
後はお願い。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to us.
We only have one chance.
Yui! Here it comes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せて……
チャンスは一回だ。
ユイ、
来るぞ！
